issue_context.title: Return out of order results for query `cluster_slow_query` with order by
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```
tiup playground nightly --db 2 --tiflash 0
mysql --comments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 -uroot --local-infile=1 -e "use test;create table t(a int); insert into t values (1);"
mysql --comments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 -uroot --local-infile=1 -e "use test;select sleep(1.1) from t;"
mysql --comments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4001 -uroot --local-infile=1 -e "use test;select sleep(1.1) from t;"
mysql --comments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4001 -uroot --local-infile=1 -e "use test;select sleep(1.1) from t;"
mysql --comments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 -uroot --local-infile=1 -e "use test;select sleep(1.1) from t;"
mysql --comments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4001 -uroot --local-infile=1 -e "select time from information_schema.cluster_slow_query order by time;"
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

return values are ordered.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

sometimes the results are out of order.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
```
mysql> select tidb_version();
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| tidb_version()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Release Version: v8.0.0-alpha-435-gb55c855142
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: b55c8551421852bae33af671fa1bfc3f605bb494
Git Branch: HEAD
UTC Build Time: 2024-03-08 07:11:55
GoVersion: go1.21.6
Race Enabled: false
Check Table Before Drop: false
Store: tikv |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
comments:
The plan is show below, I think it should add a Sort executor when reader `CLUSTER_SLOW_QUERY` table.
```
mysql> explain select time from information_schema.cluster_slow_query order by time;
+------------------------+----------+-----------+--------------------------+-------------------------------+
| id                     | estRows  | task      | access object            | operator info                 |
+------------------------+----------+-----------+--------------------------+-------------------------------+
| TableReader_11         | 10000.00 | root      |                          | data:TableFullScan_10         |
| └─TableFullScan_10     | 10000.00 | cop[tidb] | table:CLUSTER_SLOW_QUERY | keep order:true, stats:pseudo |
+------------------------+----------+-----------+--------------------------+-------------------------------+
2 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```

A quick fix just like codes shown below. But after such codes, https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/20236 should reopen. Maybe we could do merge sort between all TiDB nodes.
```diff
diff --git a/pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go b/pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go
index 62f179491a..c2b17f4d1c 100644
--- a/pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go
+++ b/pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go
@@ -2490,6 +2490,10 @@ func (ds *DataSource) convertToTableScan(prop *property.PhysicalProperty, candid
        task = copTask
        if candidate.isMatchProp {
                copTask.keepOrder = true
+               if ds.table.Type().IsClusterTable() {
+                       // TableScan with cluster table can't keep order.
+                       return invalidTask, nil
+               }
                if ds.tableInfo.GetPartitionInfo() != nil {
                        // TableScan on partition table on TiFlash can't keep order.
                        if ts.StoreType == kv.TiFlash {

```

A better plan shoud be like 
```
TopN
└─TableReader
  └─Limit
    └─TableFullScan(keepOrder = true)
```

review_comments: what if the cluster pk contain 2 col which can satisfy the two sort item?
The slow log result is extracted from the `slow_log` file, which is sorted by date, so keep order can only be based on the primary key which is `time` column.

should we just lift the limitation for all cluster table?
like do `ds.Table.Type().IsClusterTable()`
why tp is only in is.Table  😂
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/82d1c75f-ba05-47b8-8a0e-df3c1acefd23)
Only `CLUSTER_SLOW_QUERY` table supports keep order now.
And if we want a memtable to supports keep order, it needs a lot of works.
